#### List:

- Intro: RMP
- Generation and maintenance
- Equations
- Normal ion concentrations and Nernst potentials

#### Intro: resting membrane potential

+--------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Definition   | - The potential difference between ICF and ECF when there is no net ion flux |
+--------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| By cell type | - Muscle: -90mV                                                              |
|              | - Neuron: -70mV                                                              |
|              | - Cardiac pacemaker cell: -60mV (but not static)                             |
|              | - Smooth muscle: wandering -40 to -60mV                                      |
+--------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Generation and maintenance of RMP

+---------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Effective barrier               | - Lipid bilayer with polar phospholipid heads, non-polar fatty acid tails                                                                     |
|                                 |   - Freely permeable to water, gases but not ions                                                                                             |
|                                 | - Ion channels                                                                                                                                |
|                                 |   - Activity tightly regulated by ligands or membrane potential difference                                                                    |
|                                 |   - Ion flux upon opening is determined by electrochemical gradient                                                                           |
+---------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Differential ion concentrations | - Na^+^K^+^ATPase (major)                                                                                                                     |
|                                 |   - Electrogenic                                                                                                                              |
|                                 |   - Energy requiring                                                                                                                          |
|                                 |   - Continuously active                                                                                                                       |
|                                 | - Gibbs-Donnan effect (minor)                                                                                                                 |
|                                 |   - Anionic proteins predominate                                                                                                              |
|                                 |   - Attracts permeable cations i.e. K^+^                                                                                                      |
|                                 |                                                                                                                                               |
|                                 | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2002/A/5/prize-image001.jpg){fig-alt="Sodium–potassium ATPase exchanging three sodium ions for two potassium ions"}  |
+---------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Differential permeability       | - K^+^ permeable at rest (hence most RMPs closest to K^+^’s Nernst potential)                                                                 |
|                                 | - Na^+^ impermeable at rest                                                                                                                   |
+---------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Equations:

+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Nernst               | E = RT/zF x log~e~ ( \[ion\]~o~/\[ion\]~i~ )                                                                                                           |
|                      |                                                                                                                                                        |
|                      | - Calculates PD resulting from complete permeability for a given ion (see below)                                                                       |
+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Goldman-Hodgkin-Katz | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2002/A/5/prize-image002.jpg){fig-alt="Goldman–Hodgkin–Katz equation with sodium, potassium and chloride permeability terms"}  |
|                      |                                                                                                                                                        |
|                      | - Calculates PD resulting from existing permeabilities ion concentrations                                                                              |
+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Normal values:

          **ICF concentration**   **ECF concentration**   **Nernst potential**
  ------- ----------------------- ----------------------- ----------------------
  Na^+^   10mM                    140mM                   +60mV
  K^+^    150mM                   4mM                     -90mV
  Cl^-^   15mM                    110mM                   -65mV
